title: Design: Past due with two ranges ticked matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show, as in the design picture.
  • Make sure customers have open invoices in every Past due range on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Past due ticked" (ar-ap-p7-past-due-ticked.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days" and "91+ days".
  2. Close the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Both ranges are ticked.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.
  • As in the picture: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in a blue pill with the hourglass icon.
  • Only customers with an amount 31 to 60 or more than 90 days past due are listed, each with its full balance in every column.
  • The Totals row adds up exactly the rows listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R15: “The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.”
  • S5-R17: “With ranges ticked, A/R Summary and A/P Summary list only the customers or vendors with some open invoice or bill amount in a ticked range; their rows show their full balances in every bucket.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
